claims.claim: Italy's Finest Wines gives 1990 five stars, with no description.
Auction and retail listings call 1990 a great Veneto vintage for Amarone. Vinous reportedly gave a 1990 Allegrini 94 points and Wine Advocate a 1990 Masi Costasera 95.
claims.note: Search-result summaries. Individual wines, not a vintage report.

claims.claim: Aged 1990 Amarones are described as raisined and earthy, velvety, with dried mushroom and cherry in rum notes at best. Style varies a lot by producer, and the wines are now mature.

conflicts: Sources differ by producer: a 1990 Quintarelli was called fresh and medium-bodied, a Vaio Armaron full-bodied, a Bertani savoury and mature.
gaps: No weather, harvest date, yield or appassimento data for 1990 found.
Wine Spectator, Decanter and Jancis Robinson pages not read for 1990.

sheet.vintage: 1990 is a well-regarded old Amarone year. Good bottles are now mature, with dried fruit, earth and a soft, velvety feel.
